Otherwise why we did come all the way to Sulon and spent a full day lugging all these ceiling tiles out of Morgan Katarn's old farmhouse?|[[Yun]] and [[Boc Aseca]]|<ref name="DF: RA audio" />}}
[[Morgan Katarn]] created a '''map''' that told the location of the [[Valley of the Jedi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="JK2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>

==History==
The planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] had been an important historical location during the [[New Sith Wars]], but in the subsequent centuries it had been forgotten, and remained outside the knowledge of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; however the legend of the [[Valley of the Jedi]] remained in the traditions of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

The first who rediscovered the planet was the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jerg]], who used it as a secret base of operations, before later bringing [[Sulon/Legends|Sulonese]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathisers for their hideout; in that instance, their leader, [[Morgan Katarn]], discovered the Valley and the [[Vergence/Legends|tremendous power]] it contained. However he never talked about it to anyone, until he met [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] affiliated with the Alliance, and asked for answers. Rahn had been looking for the Valley, but refused to know more about it, as at that time they were battling the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; [[Precognition/Legends|knowing]] that he would be caught sooner or later, he didn't wish to have its knowledge in his mind, and advised Katarn to record his knowledge until the appropriate time.<ref name="RA" />

Indeed Katarn designed the map to Ruusan and the Valley on some stone plaques, from the [[Mining/Legends|quarry]] found north to [[Katarn estate|his estate]]. He combined the designs with decorative patterns on the ceiling of his workshop. The family [[droid/Legends|droid]] [[WeeGee]] helped him with this task, which took about one [[standard month/Legends|month]]; the droid appreciated the etched patterns, without knowing their significance; Morgan however had to hide the map by covering them with [[plaster]], an act which the droid understood as not liking them he did.<ref name="RA" /> Katarn left a holo message to his son [[Kyle Katarn|Kyle]], revealing the existence of the map and its significance; the message was encrypted into a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisk]] that could be played only by WeeGee.<ref name="JK2" /><ref name="RA" />

Not much later, during the [[subjugation of Sulon]] the [[Ghost Battalion]] under [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Brazack]] broke into [[Katarn family compound|Katarn's home]] in order to arrest him; in that moment Katarn was away and witnessed the invasion from afar, and momentarily was worried whether they would discover the map. Not long after, Morgan [[Battle of the G-Tap|was captured]] and executed by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> Ironically, Jerec would also be coveting the Valley's power, but was unaware that the man he was after, and then interrogated and executed, was the key to it. The homestead and the map remained undisturbed for the following years as Morgan's son remained away from Sulon.

[[File:Jerec-QuRahn_DFJK.jpg|thumb|Jerec learns that Morgan made a map to the Valley by reading Qu Rahn's mind.]]
[[5 ABY/Legends|Years later]], after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fall]] of the Empire, Rahn resumed his quest for the Valley as did Jerec and his [[Seven Dark Jedi]]. Jerec [[Mission to Dorlo|managed to capture]] Rahn and [[Drain Knowledge|rip any information]] he had in his mind; although Rahn didn't know the location, Jerec learned that Morgan, the Rebel he had kill years ago, knew it, and had made its map.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />

[[File:Maptilesremoved.jpg|thumb|left|The ceiling tiles are removed from Katarn's homestead by the Dark Jedi.]]
[[8t88/Legends|8t88]] working for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under Jerec,  investigated Katarn's home but failed to notice the map.<ref name="RA" /> Kyle Katarn was tasked by Rahn's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] with returning to his home to find the map, and beating Jerec to the Valley. In the meantime the Dark Jedi were sent to Sulon, and raiding once more his house, they removed the tiles, numbered them, loaded them on a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with [[grav pellet]]s and transported them to [[Barons Hed|Baron's Hed]], expecting 8t88 to decipher it. However they removed only the central portion.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />

[[File:Kylereturnshome.jpg|thumb|Kyle inspects the remaining parts of the ceiling with a [[Glowrod/Legends|glow rod]].]]
When Kyle and [[Jan Ors|his partner]] [[Mission to Sulon|arrived]] too at Morgan's home, he reached the workshop and noticed that the ceiling was missing; he also noticed the remaining tiles that were not there last time he had been. He immediately realised that some of the pattern were actually a map.<ref name="RA" /> He played the recording of Morgan and found [[Qu Rahn's lightsaber]]; hearing in the message that the ceiling was actually the precious map, Kyle looked upwards, but the ceiling was already missing; the story then was confirmed by WeeGee, once he was activated.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />

The Dark Jedi had taken the tiles to the [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]] located in [[Barons Hed]]. There it was reassembled, and 8t88 deciphered it and produced a 3d digital copy, which he sent to Jerec on board the ''[[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|Vengeance]]'' as a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]]. With the location to Ruusan now known, Jerec promised a reward to the droid, and had his ship prepared for [[hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. However, when 8t88 was about to leave the building, Kyle Katarn appeared in the tower, and requested the copy of the Map.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />
===Destruction===
[[File:YundestroystheMap.jpg|thumb|left|Yun destroys the Map tiles with his lightsaber.]]
The Dark Jedi [[Yun]] had been ordered by Jerec to destroy the stone map,<ref name="DF: RA audio">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> to protect the secret of the Valley's location from Katarn. Yun rode an elevator down from the roof of the tower, jumped on the table, and destroyed the map with [[Yun's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. The distraction allowed 8t88 to escape.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />

The droid went to ''[[Sulon Star]]'' to collect his reward, and Katarn went after him, knowing that with the physical map destroyed, the next available copy was in 88's [[Memory_bank/Legends|memory bank]]. Instead of a reward, the now-useless droid was mutilated and deactivated by Jerec's minions, and when Katarn caught up with him, he conveniently collected his severed head. Not long after, 88's memory was accessed by WeeGee, who displayed the 3d holomap he had created; thus Katarn and Ors were able to follow Jerec's forces to Ruusan.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="JK2" />
